why: Issue #630. Earned rows get no icon slot, only locked rows do, so an earned title starts one icon-width left of every locked title below it. Each locked row still has its padlock, so a check on locked rows alone passes; the case requires the earned row's name line to start with the empty slot.
killedBy: HUD achievement list (issue #629) marks a locked achievement with a padlock, not only a dimming and a border hue (issue #630)
